contentMap.productCategory: AI Image Generation and AI Video Generation
contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals seeking high-quality AI-generated visuals and videos for creative, branded, and enterprise use

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.
hero.supportingLine: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description: Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs. The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description: Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together. Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs. Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

referenceMap.heroPattern: Compact split hero with brand/logo block above a large centered headline, short supporting copy, and a minimal bullet-benefit stack. High emphasis on single-message value proposition, with no visible media asset in the hero.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Starts with a strong banner/hero band, followed by a bordered lead-capture form block, then uses stacked content sections with alternating emphasis between broad overview and detailed feature lists. Rhythm is linear and conversion-first rather than exploratory.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Simple rectangular content cards/containers with clear headings, restrained typography, and utility-focused content. Visual styling appears minimal, with emphasis on hierarchy and separation rather than decoration or glass effects.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA is singular and prominent in hero; secondary actions are sparse or absent. Downpage sections use a repeated conversion CTA near product blocks, suggesting one main action per section and low CTA clutter.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No explicit pricing module is visible in the reference pattern. If introduced, it should follow the same lead-gen style: compact, comparison-friendly, and placed after feature explanation or alongside inquiry capture.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not present in the visible reference; assumed minimal corporate footer with utility links if used, but not a major design feature of this layout.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Predominantly text-led layout with optional brand logo at the top. No strong media gallery pattern is visible; if media is added, it should be secondary and framed as supporting proof rather than the primary hero focal point.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Each product section should follow a consistent informational block: label, product name, headline, descriptive paragraph, CTA, then a feature list. Use scannable stacked features with short titles and one-line explanations, supporting progressive disclosure.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form block directly below the hero, visually separated as its own card/container. Uses hidden system fields, indicating a conversion-oriented form architecture that should stay compact, structured, and easy to complete.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, low-motion presentation with no visible motion system in the provided markup. Any enhancement should remain subtle and functional, favoring clarity over entertainment.
componentPatterns: Bullet benefit list with small icons
designNotes: Use strong typographic hierarchy and concise copy blocks.
Keep imagery optional and secondary; the layout works as a text-led sales page.
Repeat a consistent section template for each product or feature module.
Prefer clean spacing and clear separation over decorative surfaces.

personality.productType: AI image and video generation platform
personality.buyer: Creative professionals, marketing teams, content studios, and enterprise buyers who need high-quality branded visuals and videos
personality.emotion: Awe, precision, creative control, and premium confidence
personality.reasoning: This product is about generative visuals, motion, and multimodal intelligence, so the interface should feel cinematic and technically advanced rather than generic SaaS. Seedream needs a polished creative-studio feel for image fidelity and typography accuracy, while Seedance needs a more kinetic, filmic energy for synchronized video and audio generation. The page should use strong contrast between sections, layered compositions, floating proof chips, and interactive showcase panels to communicate capability, speed, and enterprise-grade quality.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The hero headline is long and descriptive, so 56px keeps it strong while preserving balance and preventing awkward line breaks.

colours.colourReason: A deep ink primary gives the product a premium AI-lab feel and lets visuals pop. Techjockey's orange is used as the energetic action accent, reinforcing conversion and brand continuity without making the page feel like a generic orange marketing site.

backgroundSystem.bodyBase: Soft cool grey-white base with subtle grid texture and faint noise for premium depth
backgroundSystem.hero: Deep midnight navy with a blurred radial orange-cyan glow behind the product visual
backgroundSystem.section1: White with crisp borders and floating capability chips
backgroundSystem.section2: Very light slate with split panels and interactive tabs
backgroundSystem.section3: Dark gradient band for Seedance with cinematic overlays and motion cues

layout.heroBackground: Full-bleed dark gradient hero with layered abstract media shell and floating model chips
layout.heroReason: A split hero best showcases both the proposition and a premium visual mockup. The product is media-driven, so the right side should feel like a live AI output canvas rather than a static illustration.
layout.featureReason: Seedream and Seedance are distinct enough to deserve separate, strongly differentiated sections. Alternating layouts create contrast and help users mentally separate image generation from video generation.
layout.darkSectionFor: Hero and Seedance 1.5 Pro showcase section

personality.imageryDirection: Use a cinematic hero JPEG with an abstract AI content creation scene: floating image frames, video timelines, waveform accents, and model output previews. For Seedream, show high-fidelity posters, product shots, and typographic layouts in a layered UI shell. For Seedance, show a dynamic video preview panel with timeline, playback controls, audio waveform, and motion trails. Use PNGs for UI/product visual mockups, SVGs for icons and logos, and avoid flat placeholder imagery. If needed, enrich with CSS-based gradient meshes, glassy chips, and metric cards.
personality.designPersonality: Cinematic, intelligent, premium, and production-ready. Feels like a high-end creative AI lab with enterprise trust cues, strong product separation, and interactive showcase energy.

designIntent.audience: Professionals seeking high-quality AI-generated visuals and videos for creative, branded, and enterprise use
designIntent.primaryUserIntent: Evaluate Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro for professional content production and request a quote or demo

brandDirection.tone: Expert, technically credible, and conversion-focused with a polished enterprise feel
brandDirection.visualStyle: Text-led, structured layout with strong hierarchy, compact cards, minimal decoration, and clear separation between product modules

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish immediate value proposition for AI image and video generation, and drive first conversion action
Explain Seedream 4.5 as the image-generation solution with practical feature depth and a demo-driven CTA
Explain Seedance 1.5 Pro as the video-generation solution with capability-led differentiation
Provide quote-oriented buying clarity for both products and reinforce commercial intent
Add credibility through role-based proof from creative and video professionals

componentNeeds.notes: Use a strong headline, concise subheadline, supporting line, and two CTA buttons. Since the reference pattern is text-led and no hero media is provided, keep the hero visually anchored by typography and a minimal benefit stack.
Translate the banner features into short scannable benefits: image generation, video with audio, multimodal creation, enterprise-ready infrastructure.
Present the 5 feature points as bordered cards with consistent heading hierarchy. Keep explanatory copy compact and outcome-oriented.
Use 'Request Demo' as the section-level conversion action; avoid competing secondary actions.
Mirror the Seedream structure for consistency, but allow the audio-visual synchronization and cinematic motion items to stand out visually through sequencing or emphasis.
Since pricing is quote-led rather than transactional, keep the module compact and comparison-friendly. Emphasize the starting price only where provided and use 'Get Quote' as the action.
Use the three complete testimonials only. Do not invent or repair the truncated quote beyond trimming it for display if needed.

layoutStrategy.hero: Centered, high-contrast hero with strong white/light typography on a primary-colored background, minimal clutter, and a single dominant message. Keep CTA pair prominent and visually balanced.
layoutStrategy.features: Use stacked feature sections with clean white cards, clear section labels, and alternating emphasis between image-generation and video-generation capabilities. Maintain a linear scan path from overview to feature detail.
layoutStrategy.proof: Place testimonials after pricing to support conversion with role-based credibility from creative and video professionals. Use restrained card styling with visible quote hierarchy.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Treat pricing as inquiry-oriented rather than ecommerce. Use compact cards, clear includes lists, and quote CTAs. Avoid heavy price comparison UI since one plan has no visible price and the other has a starting price only.
layoutStrategy.form: No dedicated form section is provided. Use section CTAs as the main lead capture path and keep the flow conversion-first without adding a new lead form.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Use the default Techjockey typography pairing unless brand review suggests a more technical direction: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body. Lean into a trust-led palette with dark primary grounding, clean white cards, subtle borders, and a restrained accent for CTAs. Keep spacing generous and systemized to support dense content without visual fatigue.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design this as a single-product, lead-generation landing page with a strong text-led hero, two large product explanation blocks, quote-oriented pricing, and compact testimonial proof. Keep the experience structured, enterprise-safe, and conversion-first. Prioritize hierarchy, scannability, and consistency across both product modules, with minimal decorative treatment and clear CTA repetition.

figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: default brand tokens with marketing emphasis; use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body, Techjockey accent-driven CTA treatment, light grey separation bands, white cards, and minimal text-led hero without media

sections.variantHint: compact split-hero-inspired but media-free centered hero; dark brand-backed band with logo block, headline, supporting line, and benefit bullets; single prominent CTA
sections.notes: Use a centered hero frame because no product UI screenshot is provided. Keep it conversion-first with one primary CTA only. Place a compact brand/logo block above the headline. Include 3–5 short bullet benefits from extras banner features. No secondary CTA text because input is empty. Keep hero background in brand primary tone with light text.

sections.variantHint: badge row + short utility stats row; use default Techjockey trust signals because trust data is empty
sections.notes: Render as a light grey band below hero for separation. Since input trust badges/social proof/customer count are empty, use brand trust signals as compact pills or stat dividers: 1,00,000+ businesses, Genuine licenses, Free implementation support, Best price guaranteed. Keep it sparse and horizontally centered.

sections.variantHint: centered bordered card; treat as compact quote-request module using inferred lead-gen pattern
sections.notes: Insert a bordered form-style card after the trust bar to match the reference rhythm. Because form fields are empty, create a compact inquiry container with placeholder-safe structure for B2B lead capture: name, work email, company, requirement, and CTA. Use the main action language from product CTAs: Request Demo / Get Quote. This should feel like a conversion step, not a long form page.

sections.variantHint: text-led two-column section; left narrative + CTA, right 5-feature grid card stack or compact feature matrix
sections.notes: Present Seedream 4.5 as the first detailed product block. Use a strong section headline, descriptive paragraph, then a repeated CTA. On desktop, structure as two columns: left for overview and CTA, right for five feature cards. Keep cards simple rectangles with border and 24px padding. Ensure the section title clearly maps to AI image generation.

sections.variantHint: text-led two-column section; alternate emphasis to maintain linear rhythm, with feature list emphasis and no CTA clutter
sections.notes: Present Seedance 1.5 Pro directly after Seedream 4.5 as the second product block. Use the section headline and description with a five-feature card grid. Since primary CTA is empty, do not invent a second CTA here; keep the focus on capabilities and the price card later. Maintain alternating section emphasis by switching the text/feature balance relative to the previous block if needed.

sections.variantHint: two stacked capability callouts derived from extras; each with short headline, description, and 3 supporting micro-points
sections.notes: Use the extras lines to create one section with two capability panels: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance and Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro. This section should reinforce value after the product feature blocks. Keep the cards restrained and utility-focused, using simple headings and concise supporting copy only.

sections.variantHint: two-card comparison layout with centered headers and one prominent CTA per plan; follow lead-gen style rather than ecommerce
sections.notes: Use a two-card pricing layout or quote cards even though reference has no explicit pricing module. For Seedream 4.5, leave price blank and emphasize 'Get Quote'. For Seedance 1.5 Pro, show starting price exactly as provided and preserve quote CTA. Include includes checklist, trust line, and clear visual hierarchy. Cards should be compact and comparison-friendly, placed after features.

sections.variantHint: 3-column card grid using star rating, quote, author, designation; keep one incomplete quote card only if necessary but visually de-emphasized
sections.notes: Render three complete testimonials from the input and either omit or visually suppress the incomplete fourth quote. Each card should have gold star rating, italic quote, bold author name, and grey designation/company line. Use the standard testimonial card treatment with left accent border. Keep the grid clean and evenly spaced.

sections.variantHint: compact closing banner with one-line promise and repeat CTA; keep minimal because no dedicated form content exists
sections.notes: Add a short closing conversion prompt after testimonials to repeat the main action without CTA clutter. Since the form section is empty, this should be a lightweight inquiry prompt or final button strip rather than a full form. Keep the message generic and aligned with 'Generate with AI' / 'Request Demo' / 'Get Quote' options based on the surrounding modules.

sections.variantHint: single-column text-only hero; stacked logo block, headline, supporting line, bullets, primary CTA full width
sections.notes: Use a vertical stacked hero with no media. Keep the headline within mobile-safe line lengths using the 16+ word rule. Bullets should collapse into a short stacked list. Primary CTA full width. No secondary CTA since none is provided.

sections.variantHint: single-column trust pills or two-row chip wrap; use Techjockey trust signals
sections.notes: Compress the trust bar into wrapped chips or a short stacked stat list to avoid horizontal crowding. Use a light grey background band. Keep text brief and legible.

sections.variantHint: full-width card with vertically stacked fields and full-width CTA
sections.notes: Place a compact form card after trust. Stack fields vertically for mobile. Keep the CTA full width and prominent. This should mirror the reference's lead-capture rhythm while staying lean.

sections.variantHint: single-column feature cards with section intro above; CTA placed after description
sections.notes: Stack Seedream 4.5 content vertically. Keep the section intro first, then the five features as single-column cards. Use generous spacing and simple card borders. CTA should sit above or below the feature list, but remain a single action.

sections.variantHint: single-column feature cards; no CTA emphasis because none is provided
sections.notes: Stack Seedance 1.5 Pro content vertically with one card per feature. Keep the copy concise and legible. No additional CTA is necessary in this section because the input CTA is empty.

sections.variantHint: two stacked capability panels with minimal supporting copy
sections.notes: Convert the extras into two compact stacked panels. Avoid dense text blocks; keep only the key capability statement and one supporting sentence each. This section is optional-feeling but included because it is explicitly supplied content.

sections.variantHint: two stacked quote cards with CTA and trust line in each or shared below the pair
sections.notes: Use stacked cards on mobile. Preserve the large starting price for Seedance 1.5 Pro and keep the Seedream 4.5 pricing area quote-led. Include included-features checklists and a simple trust line. Keep cards full width and compact.

sections.variantHint: single-column cards with optional horizontal swipe behavior in Figma prototype only
sections.notes: Use single-column testimonial cards, one per row. Preserve star rating, italic quote, author, designation. Skip or minimize the incomplete fourth item so the section feels polished.

sections.variantHint: short final prompt with stacked CTA button; no complex form fields
sections.notes: Finish with a minimal closing CTA to repeat the main action. Keep it short and use a full-width button. This should be a final conversion touchpoint rather than a separate dense section.

figmaExecutionNotes: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body by default product profile.
Keep hero text-led with no media asset; maintain a strong brand-backed hero band rather than a white hero.
Treat empty CTA fields as omitted rather than inventing extra actions.
Use 1px bordered white cards with 12px radius and 24px padding for all feature and testimonial modules.
Translate pricing into quote-led cards, not ecommerce pricing tables.
Preserve only the three complete testimonials prominently; handle the incomplete testimonial as non-primary or omit from visible layout.
Maintain linear, conversion-first section order: hero, trust, lead-capture, product features, supporting capabilities, pricing, testimonials, closing CTA.
On mobile, stack all sections vertically and make CTAs full width.
